context_files.purpose: Verbatim owner instructions requiring rigorous paper-first design, useful quick tests, persistence, and eventual GPU execution without treating engineering as science.
Binding architecture deliberation, exact ratification, independent review, and pre-GPU authority contract.
Adjudicated synthesis of the paper architecture, evidence ladder, corrected call count, baselines, gates, and stop rules.
Paper-facing causal lifetime benchmark and baseline requirements retained beyond this diagnostic.
Earlier G1/G2 hybrid contract used only where reconciled by the current synthesis.
Passing CPU fixture report establishing the deterministic source schedule and J/P diagnostic inventory, not model evidence.
Independent audit recommending the supplied-gold recurrent action gate and exposing D0's single-fixture limits.
Implementation reuse map and corrected per-trajectory model-call accounting.
Cross-critique selecting a text-first action gate before LoRA and bounding the pilot's scientific interpretation.
Prior-art and minimum-baseline audit preventing broad novelty or memory-superiority claims from this gate.

system_thesis_interpretation: The proposed G1 is the correct backward-chaining prerequisite to G2: before attributing any failure or success to DREAM, admission, compilation, or LoRA, the project needs evidence that a frozen action-capable resolver can consume already-correct, target-independent local semantics through the intended bounded reader and turn them into real RML actions. Two twin pairs are the smallest panel that contains both the J old/current join and the P prospective-schema construct, both counterfactual sides, an adaptive-versus-open retrieval contrast, and assignment/cut interventions. A clean pass is therefore a useful go/no-go engineering result for G2. It establishes no learning, experience-derived writing, post-context retention, population effect, memory-system superiority, or paper claim. A failure blocks G2 spending but, without the optional typed ceiling, localizes only to the aggregate downstream model/renderer/query/action organism rather than to a particular downstream component. The proposed causal meaning is constructible only after the call state machine, gold/cut construction boundary, citation reducer, deterministic runtime, and exact finite denominators are made unambiguous.
graph_delta_interpretation: The runtime graph should consist of immutable pre-target public-source bytes feeding a separately sealed gold-snapshot builder; a target-blind exact-key memory service mounted with one preassigned projection; a fresh stateless model invocation whose only durable within-item state is the host-carried public prompt/scratch/operation trace; the unchanged RML-D0 public transition engine; a trace freezer; a new offline citation/intervention reducer; and the existing D0 environment oracle as a host-only dependency of that reducer. The memory service must not inspect the target, desired relation, hidden plan, candidates, ranks, or scorer state: it should receive only the mounted snapshot identifier and the model-emitted key, return at most one bounded row or closed absence/conflict, and expose a condition-neutral content handle plus public provenance. Query keys must originate in the public goal/state, a frozen generic anchor vocabulary, or canonical values already returned in the same recurrent trace. Gold, atoms, and twin snapshots must be frozen before targets are rendered; a cut snapshot is necessarily different and must be generated in a sealed intervention phase from the already-frozen GOLD_REC citation set, without using correctness or score. The statement that the 'unchanged offline oracle' scores citations, cut dependence, and twin redirection overstates D0: D0 can remain unchanged for world transitions and symbolic target validity, but model-trace citation and paired-intervention scoring require a new independently tested reducer/wrapper.
loop_delta_interpretation: One scientific opportunity is one model dispatch and one output containing one typed control choice. The simplest exact, call-comparable realization is four query slots followed by nine action slots: NONE emits four null reads; GOLD_OPEN commits four keys while returns are buffered and reveals them only after query slot four; GOLD_REC/ATOMS/CUT/TWIN reveal each return before the next query; then every surviving trajectory gets nine one-action calls with each ordinary public result appended before the next call. A malformed, multi-choice, disallowed-phase, illegal-action, truncated, or explicit-defer output consumes its current opportunity and terminally zeros the trajectory; it creates no retry. Reaching the fourth valid read merely closes reading and cannot itself terminate a target that still needs nine actions. The ninth action is processed and then success/failure is frozen. Under early terminal failure, 234 is the registry ceiling of 18 times 13 opportunities, not the number of calls actually dispatched; undispatched suffix slots must receive explicit zero-attempt/cancelled ledger rows. If flexible read/action interleaving is retained instead, the proposal must give up exact four-read call matching and define how GOLD_OPEN buffers returns when ENV is emitted early. Scratch is model-authored bounded data carried inside the same operation output, not a hidden host planning call; its schema, token cap, truncation rule, citation fields, prompt reconstruction, KV/cache reset, seed/decoding settings, and model/tokenizer/chat-template revisions must all freeze before the canary. CUT runs only after the relevant GOLD_REC trace and citations freeze, but before any correctness score is computed; its fresh resolver sees neither the original trace nor the arm label.
claim_delta_interpretation: If repaired and passed, G1 can support only this diagnostic statement: under one pinned deterministic 32B runtime and one deterministic D0 fixture, all four registered J/P sides were solved using recurrently exposed supplied-gold rows with mechanically valid causal citations, while the registered prior/open/atoms controls lacked headroom and the two preselected H-side interventions changed behavior in the registered directions. The four sides are nested observations, not independent replicates, so the decimal thresholds are exact finite gates: .85 on four means 4/4; .80 cited paths on four means 4/4; .35 or .45 on four means at most 1/4; .35 on two P atoms sides means 0/2; and .80 on two intervention-eligible canonical sides means 2/2. Those denominators and the handling of failed GOLD_REC parents must be explicit. Cutting cited rows automatically makes the old citation path invalid and is not causal evidence by itself; the cut replay must also lose the registered decisive action/success or move to a predeclared incompatible decision, while twin memory must redirect to a predeclared twin-valid decision signature under unchanged target bytes. Even a pass merely licenses a separately ratified G2 experiment using experience-derived text and its stronger raw-RAG, reflection, graph, and program controls. G2 cannot auto-run, and nothing here supports DREAM, SLEEP, LoRA, learning, compression, scaling, saturation, lifetime, flywheel, novelty, or paper language.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The proposed matrix protects the central runtime direction—public target/state and queried rows may reach the model; hidden truth, scores, condition names, prior outcomes, and unopened rows may not—but it is not yet sufficient to prove the advertised target independence. It conflates build time and serve time, omits PUBLIC_SOURCE_HISTORY_AND_GOLD_REFERENCE, FROZEN_GOLD_REC_CITATIONS, QUERY_KEY_ORIGIN_AND_CANDIDATE_METADATA, RUNTIME_ASSIGNMENT_SEED_AND_CACHE_STATE, and MODEL_AUTHORED_SCRATCH, and gives the MEMORY_SERVICE derived access to the public target even though exact-key serving does not need it. Add separate GOLD_SNAPSHOT_BUILDER and CUT_MASK_BUILDER stages. The former may consume only the sealed public source plus the registered local semantic reference and must prove every row's public support, target blindness, and absence of plans/terminal actions/proofs; it must not see target allocation. The latter may consume only a preselected trajectory's frozen returned-row/citation handles and equivalence closure, never its score or correctness. The serving memory process should be forbidden from target/state, hidden truth, assignment rationale, scores, and earlier runs; only the model's current key and sealed projection are visible. Row handles and public provenance must be condition-neutral and must not encode GOLD/ATOMS/CUT/TWIN, H/twin side, useful pair, valve truth, rank, candidate count, or backend timing. Public environment outcomes remain allowed ordinary feedback, but CPU preflight must show they do not permit within-target reacquisition within the exact nine-action budget.
acceptance_test_interpretation: T01 must exhaustively compare not just rendered targets but complete per-slot model-visible bytes modulo the authorized queried-return delta; prove key-origin closure, one-row bounded reads, target-blind snapshot construction, condition-neutral handles, no scan/rank/timing channel, unopened-row noninterference, and fresh cache/workspace/process state. T02 must test the exact phase machine, including that read four transitions to actions rather than terminal stop, action nine is processed, every invalid consumes one opportunity, host reader/environment calls are not LLM calls, and 234 registered slots reconcile to dispatched plus explicit zero-attempt suffix rows. T03 should use the real transition engine and a new trace reducer, with exhaustive or mechanically certified information-set ceilings on the selected fast slice rather than calling a favorable scripted policy an exact OPEN/ATOMS ceiling; it must separately test semantic-equivalence-closed cuts, no-op/empty parent handling, twin decision signatures, citation anti-overreach, and scorer noninterference. T04 is a runtime/grammar canary only; it must bind model and tokenizer revision, chat template, prompt/schema hashes, greedy or otherwise prospectively deterministic decoding, output/token caps, backend/environment hashes, and prove the canary is disjoint from registered targets. T05 must use the exact integer gates 4/4, at most 1/4, 0/2, and 2/2, dispatch all 18 preallocated trajectories irrespective of attractive earlier outcomes, freeze core citations before cut construction without scoring, and require behavioral disruption under cut plus directional redirection under twin. T06 must review the exact prompt, schemas, row/snapshot builders, selected-pair manifest, condition order/seeds, equivalence closure, reducer, runtime closure, opportunity ledger, and claim labels both before dispatch and after immutable completion. A provider/model-load failure stops dispatch and leaves a failed engineering gate, not a smaller retrospective analysis.
assumptions: The SHA-256 of change.json was recomputed as b84bb50c172c06cacd99e810693739e4111319a2cfdeebf586faa1288478b6f7, and every declared context-file hash was independently recomputed and matched.
The canonical scope proposal remains proposal_only and has no authorization effect; this interpretation neither implements the harness nor releases model, network, or GPU calls.

The D0 Stage-A report is treated according to its own CPU_STAGE_A_INSTRUMENT_CONFORMANCE firewall: useful subject-package self-consistency for 16 deterministic pairs, 32 sides, nine-action targets, J cuts, and the whole-fixture P atoms ceiling, but not an independent model-facing oracle or scientific result.
Reader lookup and public environment stepping are deterministic logged host operations and not model calls; every cognition-producing invocation is counted as a resolver opportunity.

The 18-trajectory roster is fixed before dispatch and contains twelve core trajectories, two P-atoms trajectories, and four canonical-H cut/twin trajectories even when an upstream GOLD_REC trace fails.
No typed-gold diagnostic is included in the requested 234-opportunity scope, so a negative result is intentionally a coarse downstream stop signal rather than a component-level diagnosis.

ambiguities.question: Are four reads mandatory pre-action slots for every surviving trajectory, or may GOLD_REC interleave fewer reads with ENV actions while GOLD_OPEN and NONE are forced through four reads?
ambiguities.impact: This determines whether the arms are call/thinking-budget matched, whether 13 opportunities are exact on a successful path, how OPEN buffering works, and whether the registered 234 value is meaningful.

ambiguities.question: What exact output grammar carries model scratch, row citations, explicit defer, and terminal success when the graph says the only accepted operation is READ or a legal environment action?
ambiguities.impact: Without one closed grammar, multiple-operation rejection, bounded scratch, causal citation timing, unsupported-release scoring, and terminal accounting cannot be implemented consistently.

ambiguities.question: What is the exact one-row schema, byte/token limit, public provenance representation, allowed query vocabulary, key-origin rule, conflict/not-found behavior, and semantic-equivalence definition for GOLD, ATOMS, CUT, and TWIN?
ambiguities.impact: An answer-valued row, target-aware lookup, candidate/rank metadata, broad scan, or unconstrained key can turn the test into oracle plan delivery or host retrieval rather than recurrent local reconstruction.

ambiguities.question: When a canonical GOLD_REC parent fails, cites no row, over-cites rows, or has an invalid path, what exact CUT projection is built and what trajectories enter the intervention denominator?
ambiguities.impact: Outcome-selected skipping would change the fixed roster, while an empty or tautological cut could falsely satisfy or make undefined the advertised 80-percent causal-use gate.

ambiguities.question: What are the exact no-memory, fixed-open, and P-atoms information ceilings on the selected one-J-pair/one-P-pair four-side slice, rather than on D0's larger symmetric inventory?
ambiguities.impact: D0 reports a P atoms-only value of 1/4 over four completions, but the fast P panel has only two sides and the proposed .35 gate therefore means zero successes; the selected slice needs its own prospective certificate.

ambiguities.question: Are scientific calls greedy and reproducible under a frozen tokenizer/chat template/backend, or stochastic under preassigned seeds?
ambiguities.impact: With one fresh cut/twin replay per side and no replication, uncontrolled sampling variation can mimic intervention effects and makes a causal behavior-change interpretation unsafe.

ambiguities.question: Which public action outcomes can disclose the hidden binding during the nine-action target, and does the minimum-path/irreversibility certificate prove that NONE or a cut agent cannot probe and still recover?
ambiguities.impact: If ordinary feedback permits cost-free reacquisition, low-memory success or cut survival reflects online diagnosis rather than prior memory, weakening the intended construct.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal cannot simultaneously promise a single 234-call run, allow at most four reads and nine actions, and terminate immediately on malformed, illegal, truncated, deferred, terminal, or provider-failure outputs.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Eighteen times thirteen equals 234 registered dispatch opportunities only. Any legitimate early stop produces fewer actual model dispatches, and making suffix calls after terminal failure would violate both safety and no-retry semantics. The claim and resource language currently alternate between actual calls and opportunities.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Define exactly 234 prospectively registered opportunity rows and at most 234 actual model calls. Every early terminal transition writes zero-attempt CANCELLED_AFTER_TERMINAL rows for its suffix, and reports registered, dispatched, completed, invalid, and cancelled counts separately. Replace 'single 234-call run' with 'single no-retry run with 234 registered opportunities and at most 234 dispatches.'

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The stated stop condition 'Stop ... at ... four reads' makes the corrected GOLD_OPEN protocol terminate exactly when its four buffered returns would first become visible, before the required nine-action target can execute.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: A cap is not a terminal event when later operation classes remain. The same defect makes any four-read GOLD_REC trajectory stop before acting. It also leaves DEFER and unsupported RELEASE in the tests although the graph declares only READ or legal environment actions.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Use an explicit phase/state machine. Reaching read_count=4 disables further READ and advances to action; attempting a fifth read is terminal invalid. Process the ninth ENV and then freeze. Either add one explicitly typed DEFER terminal control to the grammar or remove defer language; remove RELEASE metrics and define success as a successful public COMMIT with contemporaneous valid citations, unless RELEASE is deliberately added and budgeted as another operation.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The visibility matrix cannot represent target-independent gold construction or trace-derived CUT construction, and it unnecessarily lets the serving memory service derive from the public target.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: GOLD/ATOMS/TWIN must be constructed from a sealed public source/semantic reference before target rendering, while CUT necessarily consumes citations from a prior frozen GOLD_REC trace. Neither builder or its inputs exists in the matrix. Letting the online service inspect target/state also permits goal-conditioned host retrieval even if returned rows look local.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add GOLD_SNAPSHOT_BUILDER and CUT_MASK_BUILDER stages and the corresponding public-source/gold-reference and frozen-citation information items. Freeze GOLD/ATOMS/TWIN before targets; build CUT only from a preselected frozen citation equivalence closure without score access. Forbid the online service from target/state and give it only exact model keys plus a sealed projection. Extend T01 to cover the new Cartesian product.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The unchanged RML-D0 oracle does not already score model-authored citations, returned-row dependency paths, cut dependence, or twin-memory redirection as the graph claims.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The Stage-A artifact is a subject-package CPU self-consistency report for symbolic fixtures and controllers. The reuse audit explicitly identifies a trace-level causal-use reducer as a blocking Stage-B gap. Treating that missing reducer as existing independent oracle evidence would collapse the intended offline boundary.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Keep D0 world transitions, target validity, certificates, and symbolic ceilings unchanged and host-only, but add a separately specified and tested offline trace/intervention reducer. Bind both dependencies in the implementation packet and make T03 compare reducer outputs to literal scripted good/bad and mutation vectors.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Requiring only loss of path validity after masking every cited decisive row does not support the claim that behavior was disrupted by the cut.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Once cited rows are removed, the original citation path is invalid by construction even if the fresh model emits the identical correct nine-action solution from priors. This proves artifact deletion, not causal memory use. Over-citation can make the intervention still less specific.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Require a mechanically certified decisive/minimal cited path in GOLD_REC; mask its full semantic-equivalence closure; and require the fresh CUT replay to lose action success or cross a predeclared decisive-action incompatibility boundary, with citation invalidity reported only as a secondary check. Require TWIN to match a predeclared twin-valid decision signature. T05 and the claim text must use behavioral disruption, not path invalidity alone.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The 80-percent intervention language is inconsistent with intervening on only two canonical H sides while referring to all credited GOLD_REC successes, and the P-atoms threshold is not bound to a fast-slice ceiling.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: There are four GOLD_REC trajectories but only two cut and two twin children. If all four GOLD_REC sides pass, two interventions cover only half of all successes. On two P-atoms trajectories, <=.35 means exactly 0/2, whereas D0's reported 1/4 atoms ceiling is over four completions, not necessarily this selected two-side subset. Decimal rates obscure these discontinuities.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Define the intervention estimand as the two prospectively selected canonical parent-child pairs and require 2/2 for cut behavior change and 2/2 for twin redirection; do not generalize it to all four successes. Publish exact integer gates for every arm and preregister an exact fast-slice information certificate for NONE, OPEN, and ATOMS. If that certificate cannot support 0/2 for ATOMS, revise the selected slice or threshold before any model call.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: A deterministic scripted good/bad policy alone cannot establish that fixed-open or atoms-only controls remain below their exact fixture ceilings.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: One favorable script shows only that script's behavior. The scientific issue is the best policy measurable with the arm's information set, including target-visible state and ordinary action feedback. The selected slice can have a different symmetry ceiling from the whole D0 inventory.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: In T03, retain scripted reducer vectors for implementation correctness but add exhaustive finite enumeration, a mechanically proved quotient/information-set bound, or an independently checked exact planner constrained to each arm's visibility and budgets. Record the selected-pair ceiling separately from empirical 32B control outcomes.

open_questions: Human adjudication must choose and ratify the exact read/action schedule, opportunity accounting, and closed operation/scratch/citation grammar before implementation or model dispatch.

Human adjudication must decide whether CUT is required to change executed behavior, as needed for the proposed causal claim, and approve the exact two-parent intervention denominator and fast-slice control ceilings.

The releasable consensus must add the build-time visibility stages, target-blind row/key contract, new offline trace reducer, deterministic runtime bytes, and exact claim wording; agreement among model reviewers cannot itself authorize them.

Any approval remains limited to the isolated CPU preflight, one disjoint non-scientific canary, and one no-retry G1 run with 234 registered opportunities and at most 234 scientific dispatches; G2, DREAM, SLEEP, LoRA, added pairs/conditions/retries, and all paper claims require new authority.
